description: AICTIONBOT™ portfolio check by KULIC Advisory, built on the Execution Toolkit template T15 (transformation portfolio summary). Takes the project register (project, owner, progress in percent, start and target date, budget and spent where available, reported status, decision required, top risk) and returns per project the share of time elapsed, budget burn, schedule and cost index, a calculated traffic light with the reason (past the target date, over budget, budget burning faster than progress, progress behind time, blocked, no owner or several owners) and the projects reported green that calculate red. For the portfolio: counts per colour, average progress, budget, spent and forecast at completion, and the decisions needed. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

projects.description: Rows: project, owner, progress (percent), start, target (end date), budget, spent, rag (reported status), status, decision_required, top_risk.

name: check_portfolio
title: Portfolio traffic light: progress against time and budget per project, overdue, over budget, no owner, reported green but calculating red, forecast at completion
